answer: The pulse edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 15 clones produces a signature the onyx analysis flags immediately. An adversary must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the dawn settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
